systems.goal: Attach to a nearby building surface along the camera aim ray, then use GTA IV velocity with a spring tether to create pendulum-like movement.
systems.failure_behavior: If the camera ray has no valid occluded point above the player, show an aim-at-a-building prompt and do not attach.
systems.verification_basis: Uses documented CLEO Redux native calls; anchor visibility and velocity feel require in-game validation.

systems.goal: While attached, holding the zip key accelerates toward the anchor and reels in the tether without teleporting.
systems.failure_behavior: Ignore zip input when no tether is active.
systems.verification_basis: Uses documented GTA IV velocity natives; acceleration and reeling values require in-game validation.

systems.goal: When the player moves forward and jumps near a side wall, briefly preserve forward movement and upward momentum; a second jump input kicks away from the wall.
systems.failure_behavior: If neither side probe indicates a nearby wall, do nothing and preserve normal GTA IV controls.
systems.verification_basis: Uses documented camera visibility and velocity natives; the visibility probe is an approximation and requires in-game validation.

systems.goal: Teach a player to reach a rooftop, set a GTA IV map waypoint on a street, attach to a building, zip, and use a wall-run assist.
systems.failure_behavior: This slice does not spawn the player on a roof or create a mission waypoint; the player uses a Story Mode save and GTA IV's normal map waypoint.
systems.verification_basis: The tutorial is a short control prompt; it must be reviewed after observing it in the running game.
